§6Thermonuclear Weapons§f

§aFusion-boosted fission weapons. The ultimate deterrent.§f
§bThermonuclear Weapons§f are two-stage devices: a fission primary triggers a fusion secondary. They produce much larger explosions than standard fission bombs and generate unique byproducts.

Crafted with §bFusor Cores§f, §bFusion Fuel§f, and a fission primary. The detonation sequence is complex and the explosion is enormous. Wire it up carefully and stand very far away.

§cWARNING:§f This will generate massive amounts of lag! The explosion is enormous. Use in dedicated test worlds only. Your FPS will thank you.

§ePS:§f Thermonuclear weapons are more of an endgame curiosity than a practical tool. But watching the explosion from a safe distance is satisfying in a destructive kind of way.
